{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for any remaining non-numeric entries
invalid_revenue = sales_df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum()

# Display the cleaned revenue values
revenue_clean_summary = sales_df['revenue_clean'].describe()

# Check the extreme values
extreme_values = sales_df[sales_df['revenue_clean'] > 100000]  # Filter for values > $100k

invalid_revenue, revenue_clean_summary, extreme_values[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean', 'status', 'customer_segment']]"}
